title: Live Forever As You Are Now With Alan Resnick | Infomercials | Adult Swim
summary: An Adult Swim fake infomercial in which Alan Resnick pitches a four-step program for creating a digital avatar to live forever. It is absurdist satire of tech immortality and digital popularity.
why: HN commenters point to it as satire that illuminates strange transhumanist and digital immortality culture.

quote.text: one of the best way to understand some strange corners of the transhumanist culture is through the satire
